description: Get the full raw text/HTML content of an SEC filing by its internal filing ID. Returns the complete filing document which can be very large (10-K filings can be 1MB+). Use the maxLength parameter to truncate content for previews. The response includes company_name, form_type, filing_date, cik, and accession_number alongside the content. Find filing IDs using search_sec_filings first.

filingId.description: Internal filing ID (numeric). Find via search_sec_filings.

maxLength.description: Truncate content to this many characters. Useful for previewing large filings. Response includes a "truncated" boolean when truncation is applied.

name: get_filing_document
title: Get Filing Document
